enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Flaming Blast 4: This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.
Undead Bane 4: Those that have died must return, and this weapon is attuned specifically to lay them to rest. This weapon deals an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Undead.
Superior Undead Guard: This armor burns those Undead that attack the wearer, causing 7d8 Good damage on a successful melee attack.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
